units.atMinutes: engaged minutes (frame dt clamped 0.1 s, only while visible and engaged), counted per character while selected
units.scale / eyeScale / roundness / jiggle /: multipliers on the grown look (1 = today's character)
units.pitchSemitones: semitones added to sfx and talk-back pitch (sfx.setPitchOffset). Babble uses conversation.json stages instead, never both
units.vocabLevel: 1 babble, 2 short persona lines, 3 persona + trait lines
units.needRateScale: multiplier on need decay (1 = no change, by design)
units.offline.minutesPerHour: growth minutes per real hour away (0 = off); capMinutes = max per absence
units.dailySoftCap.minutes: engaged minutes per local day before rate applies (0 = off); rate = multiplier after the cap
units.capPerBucket: max raw weight per category per bucket, before normalising
units.minigameMinuteWeight: total tally a full minigame minute gives (room minute = 1)
units.minigameWeightPerSec: raw weight per second of minigame, split by minigameMix
units.categoryScale / personas.*.bias: multipliers on a bucket's tally per category
units.events.*: raw weight per event; keys ending PerSec are per second of the gesture; neutral = split equally over the 4 categories
units.minTallyForTrait: tally points (about 1 per engaged room minute)
units.hint.minTally: tally points; hint.everyMinutes = engaged minutes; hint.nearGrowProgress = 0..1 ring progress
units.traitIdle.everySeconds: seconds between trait idle actions (needs moods win)
units.traitLineShare: 0..1 share of grown lines taken from the trait set
units.drift.decayPerBucket: fraction of the old tally forgotten per bucket after grown; confirmMinutes / minGapMinutes = engaged minutes
units.minigameMinScale: minimum body scale inside a minigame
